question: Should CodexBar accept sub2api as a built-in provider with its own settings, token-account, icon, CLI, and documentation surface?
rationale: This is a substantial new native integration rather than a fix to an established contract, so repository ownership must confirm the permanent provider-maintenance commitment after the correctness blocker is repaired.

options.title: Accept native provider
options.body: Keep the integration built in after the account-transition blocker is fixed and real multi-key behavior is proven.

options.title: Narrow or decline
options.body: Request a smaller integration boundary or decline the permanent native provider surface if its maintenance cost is not desired.

recommendation.title: Accept native provider
recommendation.body: Keep the integration built in after the account-transition blocker is fixed and real multi-key behavior is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across both provider integration and token-account state and is identified as the repository owner.
